messages:
ops_lead: Postmortem for INC-2027 posted. We need follow-ups that actually stop repeats: runbook rewrite, playbook command standardization, alert escalations, and assigned owners + deadlines. Pattern: KV-cache eviction spikes during scheduled encode bursts. Who takes what? Link: https://redwood.in/p/INC-2027

maria: I will rewrite the runbook to be prescriptive (triage checklist + 1-click ops cmds). ETA: Wed EOD. Will include exact commands and a decision tree for escalation.

ajay: I can own the autoscaler fixes and headroom analysis. I'll produce a canary config and metrics doc. PR by next Tue.

sasha: I'll take alerting: add noise suppression, a composite alert for eviction+latency, and a weekly anomaly query to catch recurring patterns without paging.

devon: Pushed a short triage snippet to the temp doc for Maria to fold in.

```bash
# triage - check eviction + mem + fallback
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference -c runtime --since=10m | grep -i eviction || true
redis-cli INFO memory | grep used_memory_human || true
curl -s 'http://metrics.local/api/v1/query?query=rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])'
# fallback trigger (one-liner)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.local/v1/deployments/$(cat /tmp/deploy_id)/fallback
```

maria: Adding that. Also adding exact escalation template: "page: oncall@redwood.ai, subject: INC-2027 - KV evictions > threshold, body: <runbook link> + command outputs".

sam: I'll prototype cache pre-warm and a small guard that pauses encodings if eviction rate spikes during a burst. Filing task INC-2027-FW-2 and linking. ETA: spike prototype next sprint.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2027: follow-ups created and reminders set. Parent task: INC-2027-FW in Jira.

nora: Suggest a concrete threshold in runbook: "if kv_eviction_rate > 0.3% for 5m AND p50_latency > 200ms => escalate and trigger fallback." Also recommend adding a post-incident retro check every 30 days for recurrence.

maria: Will add threshold and a short checklist: 1) run triage cmds, 2) check fallback status, 3) trigger fallback if needed, 4) notify infra lead. Also adding a small diagram for the escalation path.

ajay: Found two prior incidents matching this fingerprint. I'll add a cross-incident note in the playbook with links to the traces so future responders can see pattern history.

ops_lead: Good. Create PRs against infra-runbooks repo and link them to INC-2027-FW. I want weekly status updates until these are closed. Tag this thread when PRs are up. :calendar: :thumbsup:

sasha: acked. Will avoid paging for low-confidence alerts and use the composite alert for real escalations.

maria: tagging when runbook PR is live.

sam: task INC-2027-FW-2 linked. Prototype ticket ID in Jira: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INC-2027-FW-2

ops_lead: Thanks team. Priority: prevent recurrence. Keep updates in Jira and ping here for visibility.
